name: Miami Homeless Services Hotline
description: Call 211 for emergency shelter placement and homeless services. Free, confidential, available 24/7.

name: Camillus House
description: Full-service center for homeless men, women, and children. Emergency shelter, hot meals, showers, clothing, health care, and job placement.
hours: Mon-Fri 8:00am-5:00pm; Shelter intake via Homeless Helpline 1-877-994-4357

name: Chapman Partnership Homeless Assistance Center
description: 500-bed homeless assistance center with meals, case management, on-site medical clinic, child care, and job training.

name: Miami Public Restroom Information
description: Free public restrooms available at libraries, transit stations, and city buildings. Call 311 for locations.

name: Camillus House Day Center — Hygiene Services
description: Free showers, hygiene kits, restrooms, towels, soap, shampoo, and personal care items. Mail and phone access available.

name: Miami Public Library System
description: Public library offering free WiFi, computers, printing, restrooms, and safe indoor space.
